reviewer: Codex AI-assisted visual review; not a named human group-member cross-review
method: All 56 listed PNGs were individually opened with view_image, in batches, and visually checked. SHA/PNG dimensions were computed from original bytes.
summary: No blocking overlap, clipping, horizontal overflow, missing state, or visible secret text was found. Inputs and errors are readable; post-logout identity changes are visible.
limits: This is an AI-assisted screenshot review, not human group-member review.
Images do not independently prove session rotation, UTC microsecond identity checks, CSRF matching or database zero writes; use HTTP, native probe and SQL records.
Full-page PNG height may exceed the browser viewport; normal vertical scrolling is not clipping.
reported_action_status records the browser interaction response. A 303 screenshot depicts the subsequently followed GET page, not a 303 HTML body.
Missing-field browser checks used noValidate to reach the actual server validation; this does not claim normal HTML required validation was absent.
Old attempt3 six-image interim review stays separate and does not contribute to this 56-image PASS.
